about: One scalar outcome per Agents 101 module: the share of students who state the module's Big Idea cold, in their own words. The Big Idea text is read from the maintainer's strategy file (agents-102-core/strategy/content-strategy.md, the '**Big idea:**' line under each module's section), the single source of truth; wording changes there, never here. Everything else (story judge, taste, flags, other learnings, mood) is a guard rail. The scorer never sees which module the student took: it must pick this Big Idea out of all eight, or 'none'.
cold_question: A colleague missed this module. In one or two sentences, what is the one idea from it they should not miss?
